name: CORP
description: The CORP formed from a merger of three gangs in the early to mid 1960s: Mohawk Street (Mohawks), Hudson Street (Hudson's), and the Cleveland Jammers. The name was derived from members of the St. Michael's High School Drum and Bugle Corp, hence the name the CORP. By 1970-71, the CORP considered themselves one of the largest white gangs in Chicago at that time, with an estimated 200 members.
